content:
[95569 Interaction Design Studio | Subject description]
Credit points: 12

In this capstone project, you will integrate your accumulated knowledge and skills by planning, developing, and producing an interactive product within a collaborative team environment. You're encouraged to critically innovate and experiment, addressing specific needs and contributing originality to the interaction design field. Additionally, the subject offers a platform to consider the future evolution of your product and career opportunities in the industry.

[95569 Interaction Design Studio | Learning and teaching activities]
This subject has a weekly 3-hour studio-based session on campus. Students will be guided by the teaching staff on a weekly basis. Students gain most from the classes if they prepare in advance individually through suggested activities and working on their project with their groups.

 Canvas will be used in this subject for e-tivities, including online discussions, assessment progression and submission, a question and answer forum and subject announcements. More details of the group discussions will be given in classes and in Canvas.

 Students are expected to attend and participate in all classes, actively contribute to online discussions, and complete their work by the due dates, some set by the subject, others by their group

title: Learning outcomes
content:
[95569 Interaction Design Studio | Learning outcomes]
SLO1: Analyse a range of stakeholder needs in a complex project. (B.1)
SLO2: Apply Lean design principles and methods and explore potential research and development opportunities. (C.1)
SLO3: Develop an interactive product through a product life-cycle from conception to completion. (D.1)
SLO4: Justify design decisions within a multi-disciplinary team of designers to a range of stakeholders in a complex project. (E.1)
SLO5: Critically evaluate and reflect on the various roles you held within a complex interaction design project to inform future professional practice and lifelong learning needs. (F.1)

[95569 Interaction Design Studio | Requisites]
Before you enrol in this subject, you must ensure you have met its requisites. The requisites for this subject can be viewed on its access conditions page. 

To learn more about requisites, please visit the How to use the Handbook guide.
